tools.name: TriangleCenter
tools.description: A numbered ETC triangle center from https://faculty.evansville.edu/ck6/encyclopedia/ETC.html. Literal patched native IDs and higher IDs use reviewed site recipes; other selectors use GeoGebra.

reference.keywords: encyclopedia of triangle centers centre 三角形中心 三角形特征点 编号
details: Use a literal integer to request a reviewed extension or a patched native center. Unpatched native indices and computed selectors use the native GeoGebra command.
An extended index needs a supported recipe. A center at infinity does not produce a finite point when requested directly.
The extended data are maintained at https://github.com/ForeverHaibara/ETCproject.

examples.note: Constructs ETC X(2), the centroid of ABC.

tools.name: GibertCurve
tools.description: A triangle curve from Gibert's catalogue of related curves from http://bernard-gibert.fr/relatedcurves.html. Use a literal number or a quoted ID such as "Q036A". See the related-curves database for supported IDs. Requires Medium or High performance and a new output label.

reference.keywords: implicit quartic quintic sextic septic octic nonic 高次曲线 Q00
details: Use a supported literal number such as 12 or a quoted catalogue ID such as "Q012" or "Q036A". The selector cannot be a slider or an arithmetic expression.
Use Medium or High custom tool performance and a fresh output label. To replace an existing result, delete it and recreate it.

examples.note: Choose an unused label in place of eq1 if needed.

tools.name: GeminiTriangle
tools.description: Numbered Gemini triangle from https://faculty.evansville.edu/ck6/encyclopedia/gemini.html; optionally select vertex 1, 2 or 3.

tools.name: Intersect
tools.description: Four points intersect the infinite lines AB and CD. All other signatures use the native Intersect command.

details: The four-point form intersects the infinite lines AB and CD. Other signatures use the native GeoGebra command.

examples.note: Uses four existing points to define the two lines.

tools.name: Pedal
tools.description: Projection of a point to a line.

examples.note: Projects P onto the line through A and B.

tools.name: SecondIntersection
tools.description: Other intersection of a conic with a line through P, or of two circles sharing P. Returns P at tangency. The two-circle form reflects P in the line of centers.

tools.name: Perspector
tools.description: Centroid of the triangle bounded by AD, BE and CF.

tools.name: OrthologyCenter
tools.description: Orthocenter of the triangle bounded by the perpendiculars from A, B and C to EF, FD and DE.

tools.name: QuasiperspectiveConic
tools.description: Conic of points X for which the parallels to AX, BX and CX through D, E and F are concurrent in the projective plane. Triangle ABC is X-logic to DEF.

tools.name: ConicPencil
tools.description: Member of the conic pencil generated by q1 and q2 passing through P.

tools.name: CoaxialLimitingPoints
tools.description: Real finite limiting points of the coaxial pencil generated by circles c1 and c2, ordered along the direction from the first center to the second.

tools.name: Collineation
tools.description: Image of P under the projectivity taking ABCD to EFGH. Each line argument denotes its direction at infinity.

tools.name: Affine
tools.description: Image of P under the affine map taking ABC to DEF.

reference.keywords: collineation 仿射变换 射影变换 projective

tools.name: Involution
tools.description: Image of P under the projective involution exchanging A with C and B with D. Each line argument denotes its direction at infinity.

tools.name: CollineationL
tools.description: Image of P under the projectivity of lines taking A, B, C to D, E, F. A line argument represents its direction at infinity.

tools.name: AffineL
tools.description: Image of P under the affine map of lines taking distinct finite points A and B to C and D. A direction input for P has its image at infinity.

tools.name: InvolutionL
tools.description: Image of P under the involution of a line exchanging A with C and B with D. Line arguments represent directions at infinity. Omitting P returns the image of infinity.

reference.keywords: 对合 对合中心 projective line

tools.name: PascalLine
tools.description: Line through the intersections of AB with DE and BC with EF. The Pascal line of ABCDEF and also the perspective axis of triangles ABC and DEF.

reference.keywords: Desargues Pappus 透视轴 帕斯卡线 帕普斯 homology

tools.name: OsculatingCircle
tools.description: Osculating circle of the cubic level curve through P, with a tangent-line limit at zero curvature.

tools.name: Pole
tools.description: Pole of a line with respect to a conic.

tools.name: Conic
tools.description: Five point/tangent-line constraints in any order. Mixed inputs create separate conics (2 or 4 slots); undefined slots can appear on dragging. Add a 1-based index to select one. Nested calls select the first solution. Segments/rays mean supporting lines. Native point/coefficient forms are preserved.

reference.keywords: ellipse parabola hyperbola 二次曲线 圆锥曲线
details: The extended forms accept five point or tangent-line constraints. Segments and rays use their supporting lines. Mixed constraints can produce two or four independent solutions. Use the 1-based index to select a slot, which can be undefined.
The native five-point and coefficient forms remain available.

tools.name: Centroid

tools.name: DeLongchampsPoint

tools.description: Isogonal image of a point or supporting line with respect to triangle ABC; line images return their algebraic conic closure.

tools.name: IsotomicConjugate
tools.description: Isotomic image of a point or supporting line with respect to triangle ABC; line images return their algebraic conic closure.

tools.name: Excircle
tools.description: Excircle opposite A.

tools.name: Excircles
tools.description: Excircles opposite A, B and C; an optional 1-based index selects one.

tools.name: NinePointCircle
tools.description: Triangle nine-point circle.

tools.name: EulerLine
tools.description: Line through the triangle circumcenter and orthocenter; undefined when they coincide.

tools.name: BrocardPoints
tools.description: First and second Brocard points of ordered triangle ABC; the first satisfies angle PAB = PBC = PCA. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: FuhrmannCircle
tools.description: Circle with diameter joining the orthocenter and Nagel point.

tools.name: BrocardCircle
tools.description: Circle with diameter joining the circumcenter and symmedian point.

tools.name: MedialTriangle
tools.description: Midpoints of BC, CA and AB; optional 1-based index.

reference.keywords: 中点三角形 中位三角形 中线

tools.name: OrthicTriangle
tools.description: Feet of the altitudes from A, B and C; optional 1-based index.

reference.keywords: 垂三角形 orthocenter 垂足三角形

tools.name: CircumperpConjugate
tools.description: Antipode of the inverse of P in the circumcircle of ABC.

tools.name: AntitomicConjugate
tools.description: Isotomic conjugate of the Steiner circumellipse inverse of the isotomic conjugate of P.

tools.name: Syngonal
tools.description: Antigonal image of the anticomplement of P with respect to ABC.

tools.name: ReciprocalConjugate
tools.description: P-reciprocal conjugate of Q. In barycentrics it is the componentwise quotient of P by Q. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: ComplementaryConjugate
tools.description: P-complementary conjugate of Q. Uses the incenter as pivot when P is omitted. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: AnticomplementaryConjugate
tools.description: P-anticomplementary conjugate of Q. Uses the incenter as pivot when P is omitted. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: GimelConjugate
tools.description: P-gimel conjugate of Q with respect to triangle ABC. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: DalethConjugate
tools.description: P-daleth conjugate of Q with respect to triangle ABC. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: HeConjugate
tools.description: P-he conjugate of Q with respect to triangle ABC. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: WawConjugate
tools.description: P-waw conjugate of Q with respect to triangle ABC. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: ZayinConjugate
tools.description: P-zayin conjugate of Q with respect to triangle ABC. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: HirstInverse
tools.description: Intersection of PQ with the polar of Q in the circumconic p yz + q zx + r xy = 0, where (p:q:r) are the trilinears of P. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: LineConjugate
tools.description: Intersection of PQ with the trilinear polar of the isogonal conjugate of Q in ABC. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: VertexConjugate
tools.description: Vertex conjugate of P and Q, given by the perspector of ABC and the triangle bounded by the joins of corresponding circumcevian vertices.

tools.name: Orthojoin
tools.description: Orthopole of the trilinear polar of the isogonal conjugate of P, with the finite extension at ideal intermediate points.

tools.name: Isoscelizer
tools.description: Lines through P perpendicular to the internal angle bisectors at A, B and C; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: AnticomplementaryTriangle
tools.description: Anticomplements of A, B and C, in that order; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: CocevianTriangle
tools.description: Harmonic conjugates of the cevian traces of P on BC, CA and AB. The outputs are collinear; optional 1-based index. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: DualTriangle
tools.description: Isogonal images in ABC of the directions of EF, FD and DE, on the circumcircle of ABC; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: LinePolarTriangle
tools.description: Trilinear poles in ABC of the sidelines EF, FD and DE; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: PointPolarTriangle
tools.description: Pairwise intersections in EF, FD, DE order of the trilinear polars of D, E and F in ABC; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: UnaryCofactorTriangle
tools.description: Isogonal images in ABC of the vertices of the line-polar triangle of DEF; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: Eigencenter
tools.description: Perspector of DEF and its unary cofactor triangle in ABC, extended by the centroid of the three pairwise join intersections.

tools.name: TrilinearImage
tools.description: Point in the DEF frame with the same signed trilinear coordinates as P in the ABC frame.

tools.name: RadicalTrace
tools.description: Point where the radical axis of two nonconcentric circles meets their line of centers.

tools.name: GST
tools.description: Gibert Simson transformation of P with respect to ABC. Maps the circumcircle to the Simson cubic.

tools.name: GSC
tools.description: Gibert Simson conjugate of P with respect to ABC. Both points have the same GST image.

tools.name: GibertPsi
tools.description: Gibert's Psi involution of Q in the rectangular-hyperbola pencil centered at P. If P is omitted, use the centroid. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CST
tools.description: Cevian Simson transformation of P with respect to ABC. On the McCay cubic it gives the concurrence point of the Simson lines parallel to the three cevians of P.

tools.name: OrionTransform
tools.description: Orion transform of P with respect to ABC. Every point on the join of P and its image determines an Orion cubic through P.

tools.name: OrionPivot
tools.description: Orion pivot of P. The affine map sends each vertex to its reflection in the perpendicular bisector of the opposite side.

tools.name: OrionConjugate
tools.description: Orion conjugate of P. It is the tangential of P on the Orion cubic associated with P.

tools.name: CrossSum
tools.description: CrossSum of P and Q with respect to ABC.

tools.name: CrossDifference
tools.description: CrossDifference of P and Q with respect to ABC. It depends only on the line PQ.

tools.name: AlephConjugate
tools.description: P-aleph conjugate of Q with respect to ABC, using the ETC convention. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: BethConjugate
tools.description: P-beth conjugate of Q with respect to ABC, using the ETC convention. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: PolarConjugate
tools.description: Conjugate of P from the triangle polar circle and the trilinear polar. Also defined for acute triangles.

tools.name: CrossCevianTriangle
tools.description: Intersections of the cevians of Q with the corresponding opposite sides of the cevian triangle of P; optional 1-based vertex index. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: HaimovTriangle
tools.description: Haimov triangle of P, from the residual intersections of the paired cevian circles; optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: ExtouchTriangle
tools.description: Contacts of the three excircles with BC, CA and AB; optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: InnerNapoleonTriangle
tools.description: Centers of the internally erected equilateral triangles on BC, CA and AB; optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: OuterNapoleonTriangle
tools.description: Centers of the externally erected equilateral triangles on BC, CA and AB; optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: InnerVectenTriangle
tools.description: Centers of the internally erected squares on BC, CA and AB; optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: OuterVectenTriangle
tools.description: Centers of the externally erected squares on BC, CA and AB; optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: MorleyTriangle
tools.description: ETC Morley triangle. k=1, 2 or 3 selects the family member; defaults to 1. An additional i selects a vertex.

tools.name: MorleyAdjunctTriangle
tools.description: ETC Morley adjunct triangle. k=1, 2 or 3 selects the family member; defaults to 1. An additional i selects a vertex.

tools.name: BevanCircle
tools.description: Circumcircle of the excentral triangle.

tools.name: SecondBrocardCircle
tools.description: Circle centered at the circumcenter through both Brocard points.

tools.name: CevianCircle
tools.description: Circumcircle of the cevian triangle of P, with line limits when the traces become collinear or one is ideal. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CosineCircle
tools.description: Second Lemoine circle centered at the symmedian point.

tools.name: FirstLemoineCircle
tools.description: Circle of the six sideline intersections of the parallels through the symmedian point.

tools.name: DouCircle
tools.description: Circle cutting each sideline in a chord that subtends a right angle at the opposite vertex.

tools.name: GallatlyCircle
tools.description: Circle through the six projections of the Brocard points on the sidelines.

tools.name: HalfMosesCircle
tools.description: Circle centered at the Brocard midpoint with radius R sin²(omega).

tools.name: MosesCircle
tools.description: Circle centered at the Brocard midpoint and tangent to the nine-point circle.

tools.name: IncenterExcenterCircles
tools.description: Circles whose diameters join the incenter to the excenters opposite A, B and C. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: JohnsonCircles
tools.description: Circles through H and each opposite side pair in order BC, CA and AB. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: PowerCircles
tools.description: Circles centered at the side midpoints through the opposite vertices. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: VertexSoddyCircles

tools.name: InnerSoddyCircle
tools.description: The inner Soddy circle of the three vertex circles.

tools.name: OuterSoddyCircle
tools.description: The outer Soddy circle of the three vertex circles.

tools.name: LesterCircle
tools.description: Circle through the circumcenter, nine-point center and both Fermat points. It passes through X(3), X(5), X(13), X(14), X(1117) and has center X(1116).

tools.name: ParryCircle
tools.description: Circle through the centroid and the two isodynamic points. It passes through X(2), X(15), X(16), X(23), X(110), X(111) and has center X(351).

tools.name: VanLamoenCircle
tools.description: Circle through the circumcenters of the six triangles cut out by the medians.

tools.name: FirstSteinerCircle
tools.description: Circle centered at the nine-point center with radius 3R/2.

tools.name: OrthocentroidalCircle
tools.description: Circle with diameter joining the orthocenter and centroid.

tools.name: PolarCircle
tools.description: Polar circle with signed squared radius. Its real locus is a circle for an obtuse triangle and a point for a right triangle.

tools.name: RadicalCircle

tools.name: DeLongchampsCircle
tools.description: Radical circle of the three power circles.

tools.name: SpiekerRadicalCircle
tools.description: Radical circle of the three excircles.

tools.name: MixtilinearRadicalCircle

tools.name: HexylTriangle

tools.name: FuhrmannTriangle
tools.description: Reflections of the far arc midpoints in their corresponding sidelines. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: IncentralTriangle

tools.name: SymmedialTriangle
tools.description: Cevian triangle of the symmedian point, X(6). Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: LemoineTriangle
tools.description: Cevian triangle of X(598). Optional 1-based index.

tools.description: Cevian triangle of the Yff parabola point, X(190). Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: ReflectionTriangle

tools.name: TangentialMidArcTriangle
tools.description: Triangle of the incircle tangents perpendicular to the internal bisectors at the points nearest A, B and C. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: YiuCircles

tools.description: Triangle bounded by the three exterior common tangents opposite the reference sidelines. Optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.description: Central triangle of the Yff dissection into four congruent triangles. Optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: MacBeathTriangle
tools.description: Contact triangle of the MacBeath inconic, the cevian triangle of X(264). Optional 1-based vertex index.

tools.name: ExcosineCircles
tools.description: Circles centered at the poles of the sidelines and passing through their endpoints. A diameter sideline gives a line limit. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: ApolloniusProblem
tools.description: Circles through the supplied points and tangent to the supplied supporting lines or circles. Accepts any mixture of three constraints and returns independent solution slots.

tools.name: ConwayCircle

tools.name: AdamsCircle
tools.description: Adams circle from the intouch triangle and the Gergonne point.

tools.name: DrozFarnyCircles
tools.description: First and second Droz-Farny circles, centered at the orthocenter and circumcenter; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: TuckerCircle
tools.description: Tucker circle starting at the directed affine parameter t on BC.

tools.name: CevianTriangle

tools.name: PedalTriangle
tools.description: Projections of P onto the supporting lines BC, CA and AB; optional 1-based index.

details: At the top level the four-argument form creates three independent points, in the order BC, CA, AB. An assignment names the first point.

tools.name: PedalCircle
tools.description: Circle through the three pedal points of P; undefined when they are collinear.

tools.name: IntouchTriangle

tools.name: AnticevianTriangle
tools.description: Anticevian vertices (-p:q:r), (p:-q:r), (p:q:-r) of P; optional 1-based index. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CircumcevianPoint
tools.description: Second intersection of AP with the circumcircle, given A on the circle. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CircumcevianTriangle
tools.description: Second intersections of AP, BP and CP with the circumcircle; optional 1-based index. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: TangentialTriangle
tools.description: Intersections of circumcircle tangents at B and C, C and A, A and B; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: AntipedalTriangle
tools.description: Vertices opposite the lines through A, B and C perpendicular to PA, PB and PC; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: CarnotTriangle
tools.description: Circumcenters of PBC, PCA and PAB; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: Orthopole
tools.description: Orthopole of the supporting line l with respect to triangle ABC.

tools.name: Complement
tools.description: Complement of P with respect to triangle ABC.

tools.name: Anticomplement
tools.description: Anticomplement of P with respect to triangle ABC.

tools.name: IsogonalComplement
tools.description: Isogonal conjugate of the complement of P.

tools.name: TrilinearPolar
tools.description: Trilinear polar of P with respect to triangle ABC.

tools.name: TrilinearPole
tools.description: Trilinear pole of the supporting line l with respect to triangle ABC.

tools.name: HarmonicConjugate
tools.description: Point Q with complex cross-ratio (A,B;P,Q)=-1 so that (A,B;P,Q) is a harmonic quadrilateral; includes the collinear harmonic conjugate.

tools.name: TrisectionPoint
tools.description: Point one third of the way from A to B.

tools.name: GoldenSectionPoint
tools.description: Point at parameter (sqrt(5)-1)/2 from A to B.

tools.name: DirectSimilarity
tools.description: Orientation-preserving similarity: four points fix A and map B to C, returning the image of D; five points map ABC to DEF.

tools.name: OppositeSimilarity
tools.description: Orientation-reversing similarity: four points fix A and map B to C, returning the image of D; five points map ABC to DEF.

tools.name: ArcMidpoint
tools.description: Midpoint of the BC arc not containing A on the circumcircle.

tools.name: OppositeArcMidpoint
tools.description: Midpoint of the BC arc containing A on the circumcircle.

tools.name: Antipode
tools.description: Central reflection of P in a conic center, or of A in the circumcenter of ABC; parabolas have no finite antipode.

tools.name: RadicalAxis
tools.description: Line of equal powers to two circles. Works for disjoint and tangent circles; concentric circles have no unique finite radical axis.

tools.name: RadicalCenter
tools.description: Radical center of three circles.

tools.name: SimilarityCenter
tools.description: External (s=1) or internal (s=-1) center of similitude of two circles.

reference.keywords: 内相似中心 外相似中心

tools.name: DiagonalPoints
tools.description: AB intersect CD, AC intersect BD and AD intersect BC; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: SimsonLine
tools.description: Line joining the projections of P onto AB and AC; the Simson line when P is on the circumcircle.

tools.name: SteinerLine
tools.description: Line joining the reflections of P in AB and AC; the triangle Steiner line when P is on the circumcircle. For Steiner line of a quadrilateral, see SteinerLineQ.

tools.name: AntiSteinerPoint
tools.description: Circumcircle point whose triangle Steiner line has the direction of l.

tools.name: Orthotransversal
tools.description: Line through the sideline traces of the perpendiculars to AP, BP and CP through P.

tools.name: Orthocorrespondent
tools.description: Trilinear pole of the orthotransversal of P.

tools.name: TaylorCircle
tools.description: Taylor circle of triangle ABC, with center X(389).

tools.name: AntigonalConjugate
tools.description: Antigonal image of P, the antipode of H on the hyperbola passing through ABCHP.

tools.name: CevianAffineMap
tools.description: Affine image of P under the map from ABC to the cevian triangle of X.

tools.name: PedalAffineMap
tools.description: Affine image of P under the map from ABC to the pedal triangle of X.

tools.name: Isoconjugate
tools.description: ETC P-isoconjugate of U (five points), or diagonal reciprocal isoconjugation of P sending X to Y (six points). Use X twice to fix X. P, X and Y can supply a line direction in their respective pivot or calibration slots; the final operand is a point.

tools.name: Crosspoint
tools.description: Crosspoint of P and Q with respect to triangle ABC.

tools.name: Cevapoint
tools.description: Cevapoint of P and Q with respect to triangle ABC.

tools.name: CevaConjugate
tools.description: X-Ceva conjugate of P with respect to triangle ABC. X may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CrossConjugate
tools.description: X-cross conjugate of P with respect to triangle ABC. X may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CyclocevianConjugate
tools.description: Cyclocevian conjugate of P with respect to triangle ABC. The cyclocevian conjugate of a point is the isotomic conjugate of the anticomplement of the isogonal conjugate of the complement of the isotomic conjugate (tagct) of the point.

tools.name: CommonTangents
tools.description: Direct (s=1) or transverse (s=-1) common tangents of two circles; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: MixtilinearIncircle
tools.description: Circle tangent to rays AB and AC and internally tangent to the circumcircle.

tools.name: MixtilinearIncircles
tools.description: Circle tangent to rays AB and AC and internally tangent to the circumcircle. Outputs follow A, B, C; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: MixtilinearExcircle
tools.description: Circle tangent to rays AB and AC and externally tangent to the circumcircle.

tools.name: MixtilinearExcircles
tools.description: Circle tangent to rays AB and AC and externally tangent to the circumcircle. Outputs follow A, B, C; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: MixtilinearContactPoint
tools.description: Contact point of the A-mixtilinear incircle with the circumcircle.

tools.name: HaggeCircle
tools.description: Hagge circle of P, through the orthocenter with center the reflection of its isogonal conjugate in the nine-point center. A line, ray or segment denotes an ideal point and gives a circle with the reference circumradius.

tools.name: HaggeInverse
tools.description: Inverse of P in its Hagge circle.

tools.name: ApolloniusCircle
tools.description: Generalized Apollonius circle PB/PC = AB/AC; an equal ratio gives a line represented as a degenerate conic.

reference.keywords: 阿波罗尼奥斯圆 阿波罗尼斯圆 调和

tools.name: ApolloniusCircles
tools.description: A-, B- and C-Apollonius generalized circles; optional 1-based index.

reference.keywords: 阿波罗尼奥斯圆 阿波罗尼斯圆 调和

tools.name: KiepertHyperbola
tools.description: Kiepert rectangular circumhyperbola, the isogonal image of the Brocard axis.

tools.name: JerabekHyperbola
tools.description: Jerabek rectangular circumhyperbola through ABC, the circumcenter and symmedian point.

tools.name: FeuerbachHyperbola
tools.description: Feuerbach rectangular circumhyperbola through ABC, I and the orthocenter of BCI.

tools.name: SteinerInellipse
tools.description: Ellipse tangent to the triangle sidelines at their midpoints.

tools.name: SteinerCircumellipse
tools.description: Circumellipse of ABC centered at its centroid.

tools.name: SteinerFoci
tools.description: Foci of the Steiner inellipse; optional 1-based index.

reference.keywords: 斯坦纳内切椭圆 焦点 老封点 Laofeng

tools.name: InconicWithFocus
tools.description: Conic tangent to the three sidelines with P as a focus. Depending on P, it may be an ellipse, hyperbola or parabola. A direction denotes the focus at infinity and selects the corresponding inscribed parabola or its degenerate limit.

tools.name: InconicWithCenter
tools.description: Conic tangent to the three sidelines with center P; may be elliptic, hyperbolic or degenerate. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: IsogonalPairWithMidpoint
tools.description: Foci of the real central inconic centered at P; an isogonal pair when that conic has real foci. Optional 1-based index.

tools.name: Cubic
tools.description: Cubic through nine points or a Gibert cubic from http://bernard-gibert.fr/index.html.

reference.keywords: interpolation third degree 三次曲线 K00 Neuberg Thompson McCay Lucas
details: The extension constructs a cubic through nine points. The native triangle-and-index form remains available.

tools.name: Polar
tools.description: Second polar line of a point with respect to a cubic; native conic polar and pole overloads are preserved.

details: With a cubic, the extension returns the second polar line. Native conic polar and pole forms remain available.

tools.name: PolarConic
tools.description: First homogeneous polar conic of a point with respect to a cubic.

tools.name: ThirdIntersection
tools.description: Residual cubic intersection after two known secant intersections, or after tangent contact at one smooth point.

reference.keywords: tangential tangent residual 第三交点 切点

examples.note: F is a cubic and P and Q are known points on the secant.

tools.name: Pretangential
tools.description: The real points whose cubic tangential is A, returned as independent points.

tools.name: CubicInvolution
tools.description: The other real points of the cubic sharing A's tangential, returned as independent points.

tools.name: PivotalIsogonalCubic
tools.description: Locus where a point, its isogonal conjugate and pivot P are collinear. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: BrocardAxis
tools.description: Line joining the circumcenter and symmedian point.

reference.keywords: 布洛卡线 布罗卡轴 布罗卡线

tools.name: LemoineAxis
tools.description: Polar of the symmedian point in the circumcircle.

tools.name: OrthicAxis
tools.description: Trilinear polar of the orthocenter or the locus of points whose polar conic of a cubic is a rectangular hyperbola.

tools.name: LiangZelichPerspector
tools.description: Pole of OP in the conic through P and the in/excenters.

tools.name: StammlerHyperbola
tools.description: Stammler hyperbola through the in/excenters and circumcenter.

tools.name: OrthopolarConic
tools.description: Algebraic conic of orthopoles of lines through P. A line, ray or segment denotes a parallel pencil and gives its straight orthopole locus.

tools.name: CundyParryPhi
tools.description: Cundy-Parry Phi image: OP intersected with H(gP).

tools.name: CundyParryPsi
tools.description: Cundy-Parry Psi image: O(gP) intersected with HP.

tools.name: CoTf3
tools.description: Scimemi image of P with respect to the conic. Generalization of the Frégier's point.

tools.name: CoTf3Inv
tools.description: Inverse Scimemi image of P.

tools.name: QAP2
tools.description: Euler-Poncelet point of the four-point set. The center of the rectangular hyperbola passing through A,B,C,D.

tools.name: QAP3
tools.description: Gergonne-Steiner point of the four-point set.

tools.name: QAP4
tools.description: Isogonal center of the four-point set; cyclic sets return their circumcenter.

tools.name: QAP5
tools.description: Isotomic center of the four-point set.

tools.name: QL2P1
tools.description: Plucker points of the ordered complete quadrilateral.

tools.name: QL2P2
tools.description: Mutually conjugate points on the Newton line; unreal solutions are undefined.

tools.name: QL2P3
tools.description: Fixed points of Clawson-Schmidt conjugation.

tools.name: MiquelPoint
tools.description: Miquel point of the complete quadrilateral with ordered vertices ABCD, or of four supporting lines.

tools.name: QLP3
tools.description: Kantor-Hervey point of the complete quadrilateral.

tools.name: QLP4
tools.description: Center of the Miquel circle.

tools.name: QLP5
tools.description: Clawson center; center of the Plucker circle.

tools.name: QLP6
tools.description: Dimidum point; Midpoint of the Miquel and Clawson centers.

tools.name: QLP7
tools.description: Newton-Steiner point.

tools.name: QLP20
tools.description: Newton-line intersection with the tangent at the Miquel point to its conjugate circle.

tools.name: QLP19
tools.description: Midpoint of the Miquel and Newton-Steiner points.

tools.name: QLP21
tools.description: Intersection of QL-Cu1 and its asymptote.

tools.name: QLCi3
tools.description: Miquel circle through the four component circumcenters.

tools.name: NewtonLine
tools.description: Newton line of the quadrilateral with ordered vertices ABCD, or of four supporting lines.

tools.name: SteinerLineQ
tools.description: Steiner line of a complete quadrilateral. Radical axis of the circles with diameters AC and BD; contains the four component-triangle orthocenters.

reference.keywords: 高斯-波登米勒定理 Gauss Bodenmiller coaxial radical 根轴 共轴

tools.name: QLCi5
tools.description: Plucker circle centered at the Clawson center through the Miquel point.

tools.name: QLCi6
tools.description: Dimidium circle centered at QL-P6 through the Miquel point.

tools.name: QLTf1
tools.description: Clawson-Schmidt conjugation. Composition of reflection and inverse in Miquel point.

tools.name: NinePointConic
tools.description: Conic through the six pairwise midpoints and three diagonal points of ABCD.

tools.name: TangentParabola
tools.description: Parabola tangent to the four ordered quadrilateral sidelines AB, BC, CD, DA, or to four supporting lines.

tools.name: QLCu1
tools.description: Loci of isogonal conjugate pairs of a complete quadrilateral. Focal circular cubic whose conjugate-pair midpoints lie on the Newton or specified line.

tools.name: QACu1
tools.description: Circular cubic of coaxal circles through the corresponding diagonal pairs.

tools.name: QLQu3
tools.description: Schmidt quartic of coaxal circles through opposite intersection pairs.

tools.name: OrthopivotalCubic
tools.description: Orthopivotal cubic with orthopivot P; decomposed limits are retained. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CircularCubic
tools.description: Circular cubic through seven points, or six points and a direction at infinity, when the constraints are independent.

tools.name: CayleyBacharachPoint
tools.description: Ninth base point of the cubic pencil through eight points, or seventh finite base point of the circular-cubic pencil through six points.

tools.name: CircularPolarPoint
tools.description: Point whose first polar conic in a cubic is circular.

tools.name: HessianCubic
tools.description: Hessian cubic of a plane cubic.

tools.name: HessianCorrespondent
tools.description: Conjugate point on the Hessian, as the singular point of the first polar conic.

tools.name: PrehessianCubic
tools.description: Up to three real members of the syzygetic pencil whose Hessian is the input cubic; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: MixedPolar
tools.description: Mixed polar line of two points with respect to a cubic.

tools.name: Poloconic
tools.description: Conic enveloped by the polar lines of points on a line with respect to a cubic.

tools.name: JacobianCubic
tools.description: Jacobian cubic of a net generated by three conics.

tools.name: ConicLineCubic
tools.description: Reducible cubic consisting of a conic and the supporting line of a line-like object.

tools.name: CubicPencil
tools.description: Unique member of the pencil generated by two cubics that passes through P.

tools.name: PivotalCubic
tools.description: Pivotal isocubic with conjugation pole Omega and pivot P. Omega and P may each be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: PivotalIsotomicCubic
tools.description: Pivotal isocubic for isotomic conjugation with pivot P. P may be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: NonpivotalCubic
tools.description: Nonpivotal isocubic with conjugation pole Omega and root P; optionally choose its member through Q. Omega and P may each be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: QACu1Inv
tools.description: Locus of fourth vertices X for which P lies on QA-Cu1(A,B,C,X).

tools.name: ConicoPivotalCubic
tools.description: Conico-pivotal cubic with designated singular point N and root P. N and P may each be a line, ray or segment giving an ideal direction.

tools.name: CubicAsymptotes
tools.description: Up to three real finite asymptote lines of a cubic, as independent outputs; optional 1-based index.

tools.name: NodalCubic
tools.description: Cubic with node A through the supplied points; shorter overloads are circular, and four-point overloads have orthogonal nodal tangents.

tools.name: CuspidalCubic
tools.description: Up to two real cubics with cusp A through the supplied points; shorter overloads are circular. An optional index selects a fixed branch.

tools.name: Strophoid
tools.description: Orthogonal nodal circular cubic, angle-bisector locus, or moving-circle locus, according to the overload.

tools.name: NeubergCubic
tools.description: Locus of point P and its isogonal conjugate g(P) such that Pg(P) is parallel to the Euler line OH, K001, pK(X(6), X(30)).

tools.name: ThompsonCubic
tools.description: Locus of point P and its isogonal conjugate g(P) such that Pg(P)G is collinear and G is the centroid, K002, pK(X(6), X(2)).

tools.name: McCayCubic
tools.description: Locus of point P and its isogonal conjugate g(P) such that Pg(P)O is collinear and O is the circumcenter, K003, pK(X(6), X(3)).

tools.name: DarbouxCubic
tools.description: Locus of point P whose pedal triangle is a cevian triangle, K004, pK(X(6), X(20)).

tools.name: NapoleonCubic
tools.description: Locus of point P and its isogonal conjugate g(P) such that Pg(P)V is collinear and V is the nine-point center, K005, pK(X(6), X(5)).

tools.name: LucasCubic
tools.description: Locus of point P whose cevian triangle is a pedal triangle, K007.
